Author: 中央研究院
Title_en: The UK Variant of SARS-CoV-2 (VOC 202012/01): Q&A
Title: 英國變種新冠病毒（VOC 202012/01）Q&A
Description_en: SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19, has profoundly changed societies around the world. Using data from the Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID), Academia Sinica analyzed more than 200,000 viral genome sequences and found that the virus can be classified into six major types. Type VI began rising rapidly in many countries in February and March 2020, became dominant by April, and now accounts for 99% of circulating viruses. However, the virus is still mutating. What is the current status of the UK variant that has recently drawn so much attention, and how might it develop?
Description: 新冠肺炎病毒（SARS-CoV-2）對全球社會帶來巨變。本院根據全球共享流感數據倡議組織（GISAID）資料，分析二十萬筆以上的病毒基因序列樣本資料。發現病毒可歸類為六大類型。其中「第六型」自今（2020）年2、3月開始在各國急速竄升，4月已雄霸一方，佔目前流傳病毒類型的99%。然而，病毒變異仍是現在進行式，尤其近日引發討論的英國變種病毒現在狀況如何？又會如何發展？

Author: 中央研究院
Title_en: Four SARS-CoV-2 Variants Drawing Wide Attention
Title: 四個引起廣泛注意的新冠病毒變異株
Description_en: In its Disease Outbreak News published on December 31, 2020, the World Health Organization (WHO) highlighted four SARS-CoV-2 variants that have drawn wide concern and discussion: (1) the D614G variant, (2) the UK variant VOC 202012/01, (3) the South African variant 501Y.V2 and (4) the Danish mink variant. The Academia Sinica SARS-CoV-2 Variation Monitoring Network shows that Type VI is still the dominant strain worldwide. The first three variants all belong to Type VI; the fourth has not been confirmed, but it is also quite likely to be Type VI.
Description: 世界衛生組織（WHO）在 2020年12月31日公布的疫病爆發新聞（Disease Outbreak News）中指出四個引起廣泛關心與討論的新冠病毒變異，分別是：一、D614G變異株 二、英國變種新冠病毒株VOC 202012/01 三、南非變種新冠病毒株501Y.V2 四、丹麥水貂變異株。 中研院「病毒變異全球即時監測網」（以下簡稱監測網）顯示，第6型病毒株仍是目前主宰世界的病毒株。上述前三種新冠病毒變異株都屬於第6型病毒株；第四種尚未證實，但屬第6型的可能性也相當高。

Author: 中央研究院
Title_en: In Depth: The Indian Variant of SARS-CoV-2 (B.1.617)
Title: 深度解析：印度變種新冠病毒（B.1.617）
Description_en: The Indian variant was first detected in India on October 5, 2020. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), by May 11, 2021 it had been found in about 44 countries and was continuing to spread to more. Taiwan has also had imported cases, all of which were fortunately contained at the border. Given the high transmissibility of this variant, the public should stay alert, keep the virus out of the country, and follow its international spread in real time.
Description: 印度變異株於去（2020）年10月5日首次在印度發現。根據世界衛生組織（WHO）報告，今（2021）年5月11日前，印度變異株已在全球約44國現蹤，並持續蔓延至更多國家。臺灣也曾有境外移入個案，所幸皆已在邊境即被匡列。有鑑於此變異株的高傳播性，國人應及早提高警覺，將病毒阻絕於境外，並即時監控其國際傳播趨勢。

Author: 中央研究院
Title: 超級傳播變異株Omicron (B.1.1.529)
Description_en: Omicron carries more than 50 more mutations than the original Wuhan strain, and over one-third of them are in the spike protein, which affects how SARS-CoV-2 enters human cells. These mutations make it harder for vaccine-induced neutralizing antibodies to recognize Omicron, leading to immune escape. In addition, Omicron mainly infects the upper respiratory tract and most infections are mild, giving infected people more chances to keep spreading the virus, which has driven Omicron's rapid spread. The Academia Sinica SARS-CoV-2 Variation Monitoring Network (https://sarscov2.sinica.edu.tw/) has analyzed more than seven million SARS-CoV-2 genome sequences from GISAID. The data show that Omicron has overtaken Delta in many countries and regions, taking less than one-third of the time Delta needed to overtake Alpha. Omicron continues to evolve: sublineage BA.1 is currently predominant, BA.2 is rising in some countries, and BA.3 is a newer sublineage. The virus's evolution will need close monitoring.
Description: Omicron 變異株比原始武漢病毒株多出超過 50 個變異，且超過 1/3 的變異發生在影響新冠病毒進入人類細胞的刺突蛋白上，增加疫苗產生的中和抗體辨識 Omicron 的難度，造成免疫逃脫現象。再加上 Omicron 以侵襲上呼吸道為主，感染者多為輕症，因而有更多的機會繼續傳播，造成 Omicron 的流行。「中研院新冠病毒全球變異即時監測網」(https://sarscov2.sinica.edu.tw/) 分析來自全球共享流感數據倡議組織中超過七百萬筆新冠病毒基因體序列，資料顯示 Omicron 在許多國家和地區都已經超越 Delta，Omicron 超越 Delta 僅用了 Delta 超越 Alpha 的不到 1/3 的時間。Omicron 持續演化，子型 BA.1 為目前主流，BA.2 在某些國家在上升中，BA.3 為較新的子型，未來仍需密切追蹤病毒的演化趨勢。
